critical_code_review_comments: routes/preprocessing.py line 184: hasattr(settings_row, 'get') check for token_expires_at is convoluted — asyncpg Record supports subscript access, could simplify to settings.get('lightspeed_token_expires_at').

sync-to-lightspeed sets sync_status='synced' in product_sync_status but this is shared with Odoo — a product synced to Lightspeed but not Odoo will still show sync_status='synced' in preprocessing/products query. Consider separate columns lightspeed_sync_status vs odoo_sync_status in product_sync_status table (products table already has both).
Table headers not rendered when products list is empty — test coverage of headers requires seed data. Not a bug but limits automated verification.
seed_data_creation: None — DB is empty (0 products). Sync endpoints correctly return total=0.
